facts.fact: Ben 打听：那男人昨天差点被赶走，说服管家见到总统私人秘书后被引见，从此一直跟随总统。
facts.anchor: They spoke for a few minutes, and the secretary took him right in to see President McKinley, and he’s been at his side ever since.

facts.fact: Clara 推断 ch02 镜面的手印是他的——那个未来人也试过开门。
facts.anchor: “They were probably his. What other explanation is there?”

facts.fact: Ben 拋出核心问题：他来是为了行善还是作恶？
facts.anchor: “Then the question is: Is he here to do good or to do bad?”

facts.fact: Ben 重提名义婚姻：哪怕只有名分，也能像现代人一样约会而不毁名誉。
facts.anchor: if we were married—even in name only—we could date and get to know each other the way we’re used to.

facts.fact: Clara 回想 Ben 的穿越：1899 年掉进 The Villa 大堂（两年前），刚穿越时险些被赶走。
facts.anchor: he tumbled into the lobby of The Villa in 1899—and was kicked out as swiftly as I would have been if he hadn’t been around to save me.

facts.fact: Clara 独自试镜：镜像与手之间裂开半英寸空隙，能量 rip 击中她。
facts.anchor: the reflection shifts so I can distinguish at least half an inch of space between my hands and the image in the mirror.

facts.fact: 她死死按住感受能量生长——「I can do this」——手沉进去了：门开了。
facts.anchor: A moment later, I cry out in joy as my hands sink through.

facts.fact: 章末：Ben 写「私奔」便条，两人手牵手 step into the mirror。
facts.anchor: “Home.” I squeeze his fingers and step into the mirror.
